Services

What we build

Web Applications

Modern, responsive websites and web applications built with React and Laravel — from business sites to full custom platforms.

  • Business websites through to full custom platforms
  • Responsive builds that work on any screen
  • React front ends paired with Laravel back ends
  • Real, working software — live and testable, not mockups

Business Management Systems

Custom internal tools for tracking operations — bookings, inventory, staff, and reporting — tailored to how your business actually works.

  • Bookings tracking that matches your workflow
  • Inventory oversight in one place
  • Staff records and coordination
  • Reporting on the numbers you care about

AI Integration

Adding practical AI-powered features into new or existing software — automation, summarization, and smart assistants.

  • Automation of repetitive tasks
  • Summarization of long or messy content
  • Smart assistants built around your data
  • Fits into new builds or existing software
